newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar closes near lows but seen well supported.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar closes near lows but seen well supported.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed near its lows on Friday but dealers said the selling had dried up and the currency was well supported near current levels.
It ended at US$0.6875/85 after trading a 0.6878-0.6901 range and opening at 0.6895/01. The Trade-Weighted Index ended at 68.31 from 68.42.
Morning selling from a local bank was absorbed with Sydney bidders prominent and support was seen solid around 0.6875.
One Wellington bank dealer said he favoured a break higher next week with demand for eurokiwi issues still strong.
There is little in the way of economic data to interest the forex market next week but a breakfast speech due by Treasurer Winston Peters on Tuesday will be watched closely.
